description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class for managing tags within the Superset project, including creating, deleting, retrieving, and managing relationships and user favorites for tags.

classes.name: TagDAO
classes.description: A DAO class for managing Tag entities, including creation, deletion, retrieval, and relationship management.

methods.name: create_custom_tagged_objects
methods.description: Creates tagged object associations for a list of tag names, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: delete_tagged_object
methods.description: Deletes a tagged object association based on object type, id, and tag name.

methods.name: delete_tags
methods.description: Deletes multiple tags by their names.

methods.name: get_by_name
methods.description: Retrieves a tag by name, creating it if not found.

methods.name: find_by_name
methods.description: Finds a tag by name without creating it.

methods.name: find_by_names
methods.description: Finds multiple tags by their names.

methods.name: find_tagged_object
methods.description: Finds a tagged object by object type, id, and tag id.

methods.name: get_tagged_objects_by_tag_ids
methods.description: Retrieves tagged objects filtered by tag IDs and object types, returning detailed info.

methods.name: get_tagged_objects_by_tag_names
methods.description: Retrieves tagged objects filtered by tag names and object types.

methods.name: favorite_tag_by_id_for_current_user
methods.description: Marks a tag as favorite for the current user.

methods.name: remove_user_favorite_tag
methods.description: Removes a tag from the current user's favorites.

methods.name: favorited_ids
methods.description: Returns IDs of tags favorited by the current user from a list of tags.

methods.name: create_tag_relationship
methods.description: Creates or updates relationships between tags and objects, with optional bulk creation.
